verdict.rationale: Gitea has no built-in natural-language command interface. A probe does find an official MCP server (gitea-mcp), which lets an external AI agent or MCP client turn natural-language requests into Gitea operations. That support is indirect, needs a third-party LLM client, and rests on a single thin probe citation. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes to NL-driven agents, and hands-on or independent corroboration of NL-driven operation.
